metadata.description: PPTX automation libraries, repair guidance, and accessibility/compliance references for slide decks.
metadata.title: Document PPTX - Sources

python_libraries.name: python-pptx Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Primary reference for creating, editing, and extracting .pptx files in Python. Confirms the RGBColor class name (not RgbColor) and current chart/enum API surface.

python_libraries.name: python-pptx Release History
python_libraries.relevance: Use to compare documentation state against released versions and note feature drift.

python_libraries.name: python-pptx on PyPI
python_libraries.relevance: Authoritative packaged release version and install metadata. Check here before citing a version. Latest release verified 2026-07-11 was 1.0.2 (2024-08-07) — the project has had no newer release since; do not assume a 2026 release exists without checking.

python_libraries.name: Docling (IBM Research) — GitHub
python_libraries.relevance: Production document-extraction library (IBM Research) producing structured DoclingDocument from PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, and images. Primary source for releases, issue tracking, and integration examples.

python_libraries.name: Mistral OCR
python_libraries.relevance: OCR API understanding text, tables, equations, and embedded media across document formats including PPTX-derived images; ~1000 pages per dollar. Docs at https://docs.mistral.ai/

nodejs_libraries.name: PptxGenJS Integration Guide
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Primary reference for Node.js, browser, and framework integration patterns.

nodejs_libraries.name: PptxGenJS on npm
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Authoritative package release metadata and install information for PptxGenJS.

nodejs_libraries.name: PptxGenJS HTML to PowerPoint
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Reference for HTML table and DOM-to-slide export patterns when deck content comes from web UI or reports.

nodejs_libraries.name: PPTX-Automizer
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Template-driven PowerPoint automation for server-side workflows. Use for named-element replacement in designer-owned decks.

accessibility_and_quality.name: Make your PowerPoint presentations accessible (Microsoft Support)
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Baseline accessibility practices for PowerPoint: slide titles, reading order, contrast, alt text, and built-in checks.

accessibility_and_quality.name: EU Web Accessibility Directive standards and harmonisation
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Use to explain the current EU harmonised standards position around EN 301 549 and WCAG mapping. As of 2026-07-11, the in-force EN 301 549 (v3.2.1) still cites WCAG 2.1 AA; a WCAG 2.2 AA revision (provisional V4.0.0) is in late-stage ETSI/CEN/CENELEC drafting with 2026 publication expected but not yet confirmed in force.

accessibility_and_quality.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
accessibility_and_quality.relevance: Recommended best-practice accessibility baseline for distributed slide decks and exported PDF/web derivatives.

specs_and_troubleshooting.name: Office Open XML (ECMA-376)
specs_and_troubleshooting.relevance: Underlying .pptx standard. Useful for OOXML edge cases, repair, and interoperability debugging.

specs_and_troubleshooting.name: MS-PPTX: PowerPoint (.pptx) Extensions
specs_and_troubleshooting.relevance: Microsoft implementation details for PowerPoint OOXML extensions and format-specific behavior.

specs_and_troubleshooting.name: PptxGenJS Needs Repair Errors
specs_and_troubleshooting.relevance: Primary troubleshooting reference when generated decks trigger PowerPoint repair dialogs or unreadable-content warnings.
